dct_description_sm:
This dataset outlines the geographic boundaries that define police service coverage areas across Prince Edward Island. These zones indicate which policing authority—municipal police service or RCMP—is responsible for responding to incidents within each area. The dataset supports emergency response planning, dispatch operations, and public safety analysis.

Each row represents a single Police Coverage Zone polygon and its associated attributes
